name: Mahou no Shoujo Silky Lip ~Sannin no Joou Kouho~
original_name: 魔法の少女シルキーリップ～三人の女王候補～
source:
Lip is an unskilled magic girl. One day, she is nominated for the next Queen. Though she doesn't know what's going on, she is ordered to stay in the human world for one year as training. Surrounded by various people, what will she learn? How will she grow up...? ----- Twelve years later, the Queen finally passes away. At the same time, the Magic Crystals, sealed by the Queen's power, explode and scatter around the human world. The King tells Lip to collect the Magic Crystals....

[From ErogeShop]

Additionally, this game is based on Mahou Shoujo Silky Lip, a Sega CD game. The first part of the story is a remake that reproduces as much of the canceled PC Engine version as possible and incorporates episodes and messages from the Sega CD version while the second is a new 18+ sequel story.
translation:
希露奇是一名不太熟练的魔法少女。一天，她被提名为下一任女王。虽然不明白发生了什么，她仍奉命前往人类世界生活一年，接受历练。被形形色色的人们环绕着，她会学到什么？又将如何成长……？——十二年后，女王终于去世。与此同时，由女王之力封印的魔法水晶爆炸，并散落到人类世界。国王命令希露奇收集这些魔法水晶……

[From ErogeShop]

此外，本作以世嘉CD游戏《魔法少女希露奇》为基础。故事前半部分为重制内容，尽可能还原遭取消的PC Engine版，并融入世嘉CD版的章节与信息；后半部分则是一段全新的18岁以上续篇故事。
